datePolicy: Research, measurement and source access were recorded on 2026-11-05 UTC. Localization on 2026-11-06 did not refresh sources or rerun recognition. Version availability is not guaranteed.
uncertainties: Only five short concatenated read-speech clips in English and Spanish; no Chinese, code-switching, music, real conversations, diarization, subtitle timing or long-episode stability validation. Public benchmark exposure is not contamination-controlled.
Artificial overlap uses all-A-then-B reference ordering. Its raw WER is serialization-sensitive and excluded from pooled accuracy; no diarization ranking is justified.

References are published aligned text checked by source ID/text, not independent listening or gold re-transcription. Strict number/spelling/diacritic normalization can count meaning-preserving differences.

Single fresh-process pass after warmup on a shared Apple M2; timing includes process/model startup and may benefit from caches. No repeated-run uncertainty or inference-only throughput claim. RSS excludes some GPU allocations and is not full unified memory.
Converted MLX model card lacks explicit licence metadata; original-Whisper MIT inheritance is an inference. No exhaustive dependency licence audit; LibriVox public-domain statement is USA-specific.

Original comparison prose has inconsistent two-decimal rounding: overlap MLX 57.06/57.07, noise MLX 11.77/11.76 and Spanish faster-whisper 4.42/4.43. Both localized detail tables consistently retain the CSV three-decimal WER values instead of choosing between those narrative roundings.

Setup and version information is dated, not a promise of current installation compatibility or future downloads. No packages installed, models rerun, audio uploaded or external sources refreshed for localization.
editingContract: Complete bilingual prose and all measured rows; exact date-normalized numeric/URL multiplicity and corresponding table-cell parity. No Review, AggregateRating, stars or invented scores. Reader body has no local attachment links.
